supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- ============================================================================
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- FIX RLS RECURSION - 2026-03-26
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- This script fixes the "infinite recursion" error in system_users policies
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- by ensuring that policies do not call functions that query the same table
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- without proper security definer context, and by preferring JWT metadata.
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- ============================================================================
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- 1. RE-DEFINE HELPER FUNCTIONS (SECURITY DEFINER)
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- Function to get the current user's company_id safely
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_my_company_id() 
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:RETURNS UUID AS $$
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:DECLARE
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    v_company_id UUID;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:BEGIN
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    -- 1. Try to get from JWT first (fastest, no recursion)
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    v_company_id := (auth.jwt() -> 'user_metadata' ->> 'company_id')::UUID;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    -- 2. Fallback to querying the table if not in JWT
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    -- Since this is SECURITY DEFINER, it runs as the owner (postgres)
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    -- and bypasses RLS, preventing recursion.
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    IF v_company_id IS NULL THEN
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:        SELECT company_id INTO v_company_id FROM public.system_users WHERE id = auth.uid();
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    END IF;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:    RETURN v_company_id;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:END;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER;
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:
supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:-- Function to check if the current user is a super admin safely

supabase/migrations/20260326_fix_rls_recursion.sql:

supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:BEGIN
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    -- Enable RLS
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', p_table_name);

supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    -- Create new policy
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    -- This policy assumes that the user's company_id is stored in their system_users record

supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    -- For simplicity and performance, we'll use a subquery that checks the system_users table.
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    EXECUTE format('
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        CREATE POLICY "Tenant Isolation" ON %I
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        FOR ALL
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        TO authenticated
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        USING (
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:            company_id::text = (
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                SELECT company_id::text 
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                FROM system_users 
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                WHERE id = auth.uid()
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:            )
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        )
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        WITH CHECK (
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:            company_id::text = (
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                SELECT company_id::text 
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                FROM system_users 
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:                WHERE id = auth.uid()
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:            )
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:        )
supabase/migrations/20260324_multi_tenant_setup.sql:    ', p_table_name);

components/AuthGuard.tsx:export function AuthGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

components/AuthGuard.tsx:  const router = useRouter();
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  const pathname = usePathname();
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  const redirectingToRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  // We rely on the user from context, which is now loaded in a useEffect in ERPProvider.
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  // This ensures that the initial render on client matches server (both will have user=null initially).
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  const effectiveUser = user;
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  useEffect(() => {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    // Wait for auth to be ready before making decisions
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    if (!isAuthReady) {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      return;
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    }
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    const target = !effectiveUser ? '/login' : (pathname === '/login' ? '/' : null);
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    if (target) {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      // If we are already on the target or navigating to it, don't trigger again
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      if (pathname === target || redirectingToRef.current === target) {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:        return;
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      }
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      console.log(`[AuthGuard] Redirecting from ${pathname} to ${target}`);
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      redirectingToRef.current = target;
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      // Use window.location.replace for ALL redirects to be absolutely sure it works
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      // and doesn't get stuck in a router state loop. 
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      // This forces a full page load which is more robust for auth state transitions.
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      window.location.replace(target);
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    } else {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      redirectingToRef.current = null;
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    }
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  }, [user, router, pathname, isAuthReady, effectiveUser]);
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  // Show loading state while auth is initializing or when explicitly loading
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  // Also show it when we are about to redirect (to avoid white screen or stuck state)
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  const isRedirecting = isAuthReady && ((!effectiveUser && pathname !== '/login') || (effectiveUser && pathname === '/login'));
components/AuthGuard.tsx:
components/AuthGuard.tsx:  if (!isAuthReady || isRedirecting) {
components/AuthGuard.tsx:    return (
components/AuthGuard.tsx:      <div 
components/AuthGuard.tsx:        id="auth-loading-screen" 
components/AuthGuard.tsx:        data-id="auth-loading-screen"
components/AuthGuard.tsx:        data-name="auth-loading-screen"
components/AuthGuard.tsx:        className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center"

components/AuthGuard.tsx:      >

components/AuthGuard.tsx:          <Logo size="lg" theme="dark" className="animate-pulse" />
components/AuthGuard.tsx:          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
components/AuthGuard.tsx:            <div id="loading-spinner" data-id="loading-spinner" className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-white/20 border-t-brand-green rounded-full animate-spin" />
